data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a modest prior-year release. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2013 and prior) produced a net release of approximately GBP 2.28m (3.2% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven principally by favourable claims development in the Marine and Energy classes. The managing agent narrative also notes an overall surplus (stated as GBP 4.8m) primarily driven by reserve releases on 2013 and prior years; that figure appears to be a net (post-reinsurance) presentation and differs from the gross triangle-based calculation used here.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development table (page 33) using the triangle diagonal method, yielding a gross PYD release of approx GBP 2.279m. The Managing Agent text reports an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m driven by releases on 2013 and prior years; that narrative figure appears to be net of reinsurance and thus differs from the gross triangle-derived figure. Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Technical Provisions table (page 22). No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross line was found; triangle was used as primary gross source. Confidence in triangle extraction: 0.8.
